businessContact.emailStatus: designated first-party Music Department email route is publicly linked but protected and not visible in plaintext
businessContact.verification: The official Radio K Contact and Submitting Music pages both link the Music Department for music delivery. The exact destination is protected by Cloudflare and was not decoded, guessed, copied from third parties or probed. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability testing was performed.

activityVerification.evidence: Radio K's official homepage showed current rotation additions, July 2026 events and editorial posts dated through July 2, 2026. The official About and Contact pages identify current terrestrial and online broadcasting, while playlist and schedule surfaces remain live.

genreFitEvidence: Radio K describes its programming as an eclectic variety of independent music, old and new.
Its submission guidance says it plays many genres, generally excluding classical and Top 40, and maintains specialty shows for records outside general rotation.
Current homepage additions include electronic, sound-collage and rap releases, supporting plausible fit for selected MarcsMusic electronic, bass, hip-hop-adjacent and world-fusion tracks.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: Radio K expressly authorizes digital music delivery, but the Music Department destination is protected and the final submission requires human release selection, accessible download-link verification, metadata preparation and unresolved international, explicit-content and AI-origin checks. The protected address must not be decoded or guessed. Do not automate the email, request tracking, use adjacent staff contacts or send inaccessible streaming-only links.

deduplication.repositoryEvidence: The complete open pull-request patch and repository code index were searched for Radio K, KUOM, Radio K - KUOM, radiok.org and the canonical submitting-music path. No prior music-submission-agent platform, runtime seed or queue record was found.
deduplication.consolidation: Radio K's digital and physical options are stored as one canonical platform opportunity. The digital Music Department route is queued first; the physical CD address is retained only as an authorized alternative and is not counted as a second opportunity. General contacts, individual staff, specialty shows, the live-performance route and promotion companies are excluded.

notes: One new free-first Radio K opportunity was queued as needs_manual_review for its explicitly authorized digital Music Department route. The protected email was not decoded. No email, form field, audio asset, download link, package, login, CAPTCHA or payment was submitted.
